stem: Which sentence from the article shows that developing soccer skills isn't the only focus of Kicking4Hunger camps?

options.label: F
options.text: During the three-day camp, more than 70 children were able to play soccer.

options.label: G
options.text: The coaches also teach children about staying healthy by exercising and eating the right foods.

options.label: H
options.text: During the school year Kicking4Hunger offers clinics that are usually held for one to three days.

options.label: J
options.text: Kicking4Hunger has set a goal of bringing soccer camps to other states by 2014 and to other countries by 2016.
